CREATE TABLE `blob` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`data` blob NOT NULL
, `touched_at` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE `document` (
	`key` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`value` text NOT NULL
)
CREATE TABLE migration (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, time_completed INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "plugin" (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`enabled` integer DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	`manifest` text,
	`revision` text
)

CREATE TABLE `state` (
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`key` text NOT NULL,
	`value` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT `state_pk` PRIMARY KEY(`name`, `key`)
)
